posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
both errors basically means that the engine has been given a reference to a data object that does not exist.
possible causes
1) continuing an incompatible savefile -> start new game
2) wrong configuration of a plugin -> check all plugin properties and plugin help/requirement
3) wrong order of plugins
4) incompatible plugins
to help with 3&4 we need to see your full plugin list

very often that is exactly the wrong thing to do, because the plugin programmer has no way of knowing what is available in your game and can't set any value to fit your project.
Just as a basic example: there are quite a number of plugins that use variables to transfer data to events. But since they don't know which variables are in use, they all default to ID 1.
and if you don't change that, then every plugin will take the value in variable 1 for its own, no matter what.
please read through all plugin helps to learn what they need and confirm or change the defaults where needed.
